handle_non_streaming_A2A_completion: handle a non-streaming A2A request via litellm.acompletion and return the A2A SendMessageResponse
handle_streaming_A2A_completion: handle a streaming A2A request via litellm.acompletion and yield A2A streaming events in order
route_Pydantic_AI_requests: route A2A requests to Pydantic AI agents when custom_llm_provider is set to pydantic_ai_agents
transform_A2A_message_to_OpenAI: transform A2A messages to OpenAI format and back to A2A response format via the completion bridge
handle_a2a_completion_streaming: handle streaming A2A completion by emitting task, status-update, artifact-update, and final status events
